candidates.name: Cocos Engine 3.8.8

webLite.evidence: Cocos Creator can produce browser builds, but this task does not replace the locked Three.js web-lite evidence path.

wechatMiniGame.evidence: Cocos Creator 3.8.8 provides the intermediate WeChat Mini Game build required by TapTap's official converter workflow.

douyinMiniGame.evidence: Cocos supports Douyin-oriented export workflows, but no Douyin package or device evidence is in this task.

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: TapTap's official Cocos/Laya/Egret guide requires Cocos Creator 3.8.x or above and documents conversion from a Cocos WeChat Mini Game build to build/TapBuild/game.zip with plugin 1.2.2: https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/dev/engine/Cocos-Laya-Egret/

attributionDuties: Retain the Cocos Engine MIT copyright and permission notice in distributions containing the engine or substantial portions of it.
approvedScope: Isolated Cocos Creator 3.8.8 implementation and build under this target game's platforms/taptap-minigame directory.
Programmatic original geometry and UI implementing the already specified core journey; no third-party game expression or assets.
candidates.rationale: The existing Three.js r185 build is browser-only and cannot run in TapTap's BOM/DOM-free ordinary Mini Game runtime. Cocos Engine 3.8.8 is license-verified and matches TapTap's documented official conversion path.

conclusion.architectureDecision: Keep the existing web-lite workspace unchanged and add an isolated Cocos Creator 3.8.8 TapTap platform project. Use only the official TapTap Cocos conversion tool 1.2.2 downloaded from the platform documentation (archive SHA-256 6b8a9a3cc62b6c54cefab397097babb771d9d99f90442cddff06310a4c9ed73f) as the documented packaging tool. The tool is not claimed as open-source reuse; its output remains conditional until a real TapTap Mini Game ID is configured and backend scan testing passes.
